parsed.rationale: All four records are empty interfaces (fields_or_signature: [], shared_field_count: 2 shared structural slots) spread across four packages — Playback, Wallpaper, MusicShareKit, and Analytics. A dedicated `Analytics` package already exists at `Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift` and already defines `AnalyticsEvent`, making it the natural canonical parent protocol. The three domain-specific variants (`PlaybackAnalyticsEvent`, `QualityAnalyticsEvent`, `RequestLineAnalyticsEvent`) are structurally identical to `AnalyticsEvent` and should simply inherit from it, allowing each package to retain its own named marker protocol while eliminating the duplicated structural definition and enabling cross-package type-erasure against the common base.
